title: Before the Throne
content:
Verse 1
Before the throne of God above, 
I have a strong and perfect plea, 
a great High Priest whose name is Love, 
who ever lives and pleads for me. 
My name is gravenon His hands. 
My name is written on His heart. 
I know that while in heav’n He stands, 
no tongue can bid me thence depart, 
no tongue can bid me thencedepart.

Verse 2
When Satan tempts me to despair, 
and tells me all the guilt within, 
upward I look and see Him there, 
who made an end to all my sin. 
Because the sinless Savior died, 
my sinful soul is counted free. 
For God, the Just, is satisfied,
to look on Him and pardon me; 
to look on Him and pardon me.

Verse 3
Behold Him there, the risen Lamb! 
My perfect spotless righteousness, 
the great unchangeable I AM, 
the King of Glory and of Grace. 
One with Himself, I cannot die; 
my soul is purchased with His blood. 
My life is hid with Christ on high,
with Christ, my Savior and my God; 
with Christ, my Savior and my God.

title: Let His Glory Be Seen
content:
Verse 1
Oh I saw a distant land, and its glory was so grand. 
I cried, “Oh Lord, how I long to be there!” 
Then I heard His gentle voice, “Come my child, it is your choice.” 
Oh such hope, that I’d never heard before. 

Chorus
Oh arise, let us run, 
for the morning light has come, 
and the darkness of the night flies away! 
He has risen, He has come, 
and our home He has won. 
Let His Glory be seen on you today

Verse 2
Then the way grew dark with care, my heart trembled in despair. 
I turned my eyes to my Lord with a prayer. 
Through the dimness of the dawn, deeper truth then I was drawn. 
Oh such hope, even brighter than before.

Verse 3
There alonely soul I saw, standing near, but yet withdrawn. 
I bade him come to the land bright and fair. 
With hope’s glimmer in his eye, to the darkness said goodbye. 
Then we sang, a note higher than before.
subtitle: GYC 2017 Theme Song

title: This Witness I Will Bear
content:
Verse 1
Have you heard the story told 
of the Man whose heart was sold 
To save my dying soul? Oh what love untold. 
To the end He’s always sought me. 
To the end He’s always loved me. 
To the end I long to follow 
for He bore my cross of sorrow. 
I will stay here in the hollow of His care 
and I will go! Anywhere to the end.
This witness I will bear, to the end

Verse 2
In the grove I heard Him say, 
“Oh my Father please just stay.” 
Through broken hearted pain He did pave the way. 
To the end His heart is faithful. 
To the end His hand is able. 
To the end I can now follow 
for He bore my cross of sorrow.
I will stay here in the hollow of His care 
and I will go! Anywhere to the end.
This witness I will bear, to the end

Verse 3
As they took Him off to die 
there His friendship I denied. 
Forgiveness in His eyes, He did not despise. 
To the end His love constrains me. 
To the end He has restored me. 
To the end I will still follow 
for He bore my cross of sorrow. 
I will stay here in the hollow of His care 
and I will go! Anywhere to the end.
This witness I will bear, to the end
subtitle: The apostles’ song · Acts 1:8

title: Our Prince’s Call
content:
Verse 1
There’s a lost, lonely soul waiting silent at war 
for a rescue to come to the door. 
Many could go but I only know 
the name of that one lonely soul. 

Chorus
Oh can you hear our Prince calling on before, 
“Let us go and restore 
the broken hearted the wounded the captives of war. 
Will you bear my shield of faith once more?”

Verse 2
Many more are the souls who are bound up in fear 
as they run through the dark far and near. 
Though I will fight just One ends the night, 
our Prince who carries the light. 

Verse 3
To that lost lonely soul I will go and will share 
all their cries, all their fears, all their prayers. 
For it’s been told my Prince He does hold 
the tears of that one lonely soul.
subtitle:
GYC 2019 Theme Song

Jonathan, the prince, said to his young armor-bearer, “Come, let us go!
For nothing can hinder the Lord from saving,
whether by many or by few.”
1 Samuel 14:6

title: Yet Not I But Through Christ in Me
content:
Verse 1
What gift of grace is Jesus my redeemer 
There is no more for heaven now to give 
He is my joy, my righteousness, and freedom 
My steadfast love, my deep and boundless peace. 
To this I hold, my hope is only Jesus 
For my life is wholly bound to His. 
Oh how strange and divine, I can sing: all is mine! 
Yet not I, but through Christ in me me

Verse 2
The night is dark but I am not forsaken 
For by my side, the Saviour He will stay. 
I labour on in weakness and rejoicing 
For in my need, His power is displayed 
To this I hold, my Shepherd will defend me 
Through the deepest valley He will lead 
Oh the night has been won, and I shall overcome! 
Yet not I, but through Christ in me 

Verse 3
No fate I dread, I know I am forgiven 
The future sure, the price it has been paid 
For Jesus bled and suffered for my pardon 
And He was raised to overthrow the grave 
To this I hold, my sin has been defeated 
Jesus now and ever is my plea 
Oh the chains are released, I can sing: I am free! 
Yet not I, but through Christ in me

Verse 4
With every breath I long to follow Jesus 
For He has said that He will bring me home 
And day by day I know He will renew me 
Until I stand with joy before the throne 
To this I hold, my hope is only Jesus 
All the glory evermore to Him
When the race is complete, still my lips shall repeat: 
Yet not I, but through Christ in me
When the race is complete, still my lips shall repeat: 
Yet not I, but through Christ in me
Yet not I, but through Christ in me
subtitle: GYC 2021 Theme Song

title: Break Forth
content:
Verse 1
All around us in this world, Sorrow is crying. 
Suffering in misery: Our world is dying. 
It is ours to help and bless, 
Give them aid and kindness. 
So we hear Christ calling us, 
Will you go, and share My grace? 

Chorus
Then shall our light break forth as the dawn, 
Love shall be our voice and song. 
Hearts will seek and find His Word, 
And the glory of the Lord will fill the earth. 

Verse 2
Go ye into all the world: That is our calling. 
Give the message faithfully, All nations drawing. 
Blend with deeds, the words we speak: 
Truth in love to those we meet. 
As we hear Christ’s call repeat, 
Will you go, and feed My sheep? 

Verse 3
Generation of God’s youth, Brighten the darkness, 
Give the everlasting word, Always in kindness. 
Deeds of love will help them see, 
That our words are true indeed. 
Do you hear Christ’s call in truth: 
Will you go, and be My youth? 

Ending
And the glory of the Lord will fill the earth.

title: But If Not
content:
Verse 1
This world is dark and filled with such confusion. 
The truths of God seem hidden from its view, 
but I am called to bring light to the darkness by living out the truth. 
While evil seeks to lead men to deception, 
God’s holy Word is light to show the way 
along a path that’s leading ever upward, towards eternal day! 

Chorus
And though the heavens fall, 
still I will trust Him. 
and in my darkest trial I believe 
that God who loves me so 
will save me by His hand. 
But if not, but if not, still, I will stand!

Verse 2
I am not promised to a life of comfort 
and not exempted from the sting of pain, 
but I am promised there will be Another walking though the flames. 
When trials come, I will be ever faithful 
unto the God who gave His only Son. 
Not by my strength but through the Holy Spirit, I will overcome!

title: See the Invisible
content:
Verse 1
Choices will come that confront us all: 
To live for ourselves or to follow God’s call. 
Pleasures of sin last a season but soon pass away 
Down through the ages both now and then, 
Many have lived for the glories of men. 
Will we refuse the riches of kingdoms that soon will fade? 

Chorus
Those who endure, those who will stand 
Are those who can see what no one else can. 
Looking to Christ, and trusting His hand, 
We’ll see the Invisible; by faith we will stand.

Verse 2
Fear not the darkness fear God alone; 
Though we’re afflicted, He cares for His own. 
Trust in the One who has yielded His Son for us all. 
He who has promised is faithful still; 
Let us take courage and follow His will. 
Thus we withstand the power of kingdoms that soon will fall.

Verse 3
God’s Word is certain, His promise sure; 
There’s a reward for the ones who endure; 
He who is coming will come and He will not delay. 
Mysteries of life will be then made clear; 
With His own hand He will wipe every tear. 
Christ will inherit the kingdoms of earth and with Him we’ll reign.

title: Wherever He Goes
content:
Verse 1
You sent Your Son to us in love, 
eternal life to share. 
His sacrifice His precious blood, 
shed for me is almost more than I can bear. 
What can I do? What can I say 
but promise You today, 
Yes, promise You today? 

Chorus
Wherever He goes I’ll follow, 
over mountains, through stormy seas. 
Wherever He goes, I’ll follow 
cause of all that He’s done for me. H
e gave His life, what more could He give? 
The ultimate price so I could live. 
I’ll take His hand and follow the Lamb 
wherever He goes! 

Verse 2
He calls me to adventure now, 
Saying take hold of your cross. 
Journey through paths unknown 
in search of souls who have been lost. 
I don’t feel worthy, how can it be, 
the Father should choose someone like me? 
But He will give me strength. 
as I move forward in faith! 

Chorus 2
Wherever He goes I’ll follow, 
over mountains, through stormy seas. 
Wherever He goes, I’ll follow 
cause of all that He’s done for me. H
e gave His life, what more could He give? 
The ultimate price so I could live. 
I’ll take His hand and follow the Lamb 
wherever He goes! 
wherever He goes! 

Verse 3
Standing before the throne of God 
joined upon the glassy sea, 
choirs of thousands shout, 
“The Lamb has gained the victory!” 
There we will sing the song of the Lamb 
fathomless joy and harps in hand. 
Just thinking of that day 
gives me the courage to say: 

Chorus 2
Wherever He goes I’ll follow, 
over mountains, through stormy seas. 
Wherever He goes, I’ll follow 
cause of all that He’s done for me. H
e gave His life, what more could He give? 
The ultimate price so I could live. 
I’ll take His hand and follow the Lamb 
wherever He goes! 
wherever He goes!
